## How every build runs
- One loop, five phases: 01 Scope (spec + acceptance criteria), 02 Generate (coding agent implements), 03 Review (independent agent on another model family audits the diff), 04 Patch (flagged issues fixed before merge), 05 Ship (deploy with automated tests green).
- Routing per phase: OpenCode orchestrates; Claude reasons and reviews; DeepSeek generates fast; Gemini handles multimodal analysis.

Evidence: 20+ automated unit tests (Vitest) covering billing, stock and CSV logic; 100% offline-capable.
